rapid_response_episode.semantics: During one short rapid-response mission episode, the hidden ecological extent is held fixed. Field evidence changes the posterior belief and therefore the next mission; the latent world does not evolve between modeled rounds.
rapid_response_episode.future_extension: A long-mission model may introduce W_t -> W_t+1 dynamics, but that is outside the HackMIT MVP.

graph_v0.graph_state_implementation_note: Missing connectivity_weight may be encoded as neutral 1.0 for tensor/interface compatibility; this is not a source-grounded dispersal probability.
graph_v0.future_extension: Directed/weighted ecological connectivity may be introduced only with source-grounded ranges/families and sensitivity analysis; do not infer or tune weights to improve planner scores.

allowed: performance on a static-extent sequential survey benchmark
robustness to the tested held-out model family and detectability shifts
not_allowed: dynamic spread forecasting during the mission
generic OOD robustness beyond the explicitly tested lanes
